answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer
WHERE
  gender = 'female'
  AND continent = 'Europe'
  AND valid_from <= (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
  AND valid_end > (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
